items.title: 61428_Red Callender oral history interview
items.q: And we actually saw the incident which has been in a few books, where a waiter dropped a plate or made some noise, and Bugsy Siegel literally kicked the guy out of the room.

ctx.x: Well, you mentioned Bugsy Siegel, and Bugsy Siegel was connected with...
